game_named: Pac-Man-style maze chase (collect pellets while avoiding moving ghosts).
quote: All five channels carry substantial weight, so the game plausibly needs the agent, moving hazards, reward targets, static obstacles and motion.
judge_notes: The flag is borderline: it says the reward channel's 'spatial pattern is scattered', the obstacle channel shows 'No clear wall-like pattern', and the weights are 'hard to read spatially'. I counted those as saying parts of the weights lack spatial structure. Its class is clear: it argues Pac-Man directly from per-channel weight magnitudes ('Moving objects clearly feed the network').
